title: 信息日报 2026-08-27

headline.title: 英伟达同意以130亿美元收购Hugging Face
headline.summary: 英伟达同意以130亿美元收购AI模型托管平台Hugging Face，交易将这家开源AI社区旗舰企业纳入英伟达生态。此举可能重塑AI模型的分发与协作方式，并加剧行业整合，影响开发者和初创企业。
headline.title_en: Nvidia agrees to acquire Hugging Face for $13B
headline.summary_en: Nvidia has agreed to acquire Hugging Face, the leading platform for hosting and sharing AI models, for $13 billion. The acquisition would bring a cornerstone of the open-source AI ecosystem under Nvidia's control, with far-reaching implications for model distribution, developer workflows, and competitive dynamics in the AI industry. The deal is expected to face regulatory scrutiny.
headline.original_title: Nvidia agrees to acquire Hugging Face for $13B
headline.reason: 英伟达收购Hugging Face是当天AI领域最大新闻，交易金额达130亿美元，直接关系到开源AI生态、开发者社区和行业竞争，对科技投资走向有重要指引，故列为头条。
headline.reason_en: Nvidia's acquisition of Hugging Face is the biggest AI story today. The $13B deal directly touches the open-source ecosystem, developer community, and competitive landscape, making it the lead item for its outsized impact on tech investment and strategy.
